newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures close mostly higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures close mostly higher.

text.p: Jan 22 - U.S. stock index futures closed mostly higher in moderate to brisk trade, led by strength in the tech sector even as IBM shares fell. Traders noted March S&P 500 volume of 85,000, and called March's strong close after afternoon bond weakness a positive sign for S&Ps on Thursday.
